name: Adrian Matei
headline: Backend Engineer – Node.js / TypeScript | Production Debugging & Distributed Systems | Brasov, Romania | Willing to relocate to Bucharest
summary: Backend engineer with 5+ years in hands-on engineering roles, including 4 years of TypeScript and 2+ years building Node.js/NestJS services. Most recently owned features for a global enterprise SaaS platform from code through CI/CD into production, monitoring and debugging them in Splunk. Detected and remediated a live production server compromise as sole engineer for a startup, and debugged card-payment processing (preauthorization, card/EBT) by tracing transaction data across layers. Builds and instruments distributed systems with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes and OpenTelemetry, and builds with Claude Code and Cursor.

projects.name: DevBoard
projects.description: event-driven microservices platform (NestJS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes)
bullets: Instrumented all services with OpenTelemetry via a Collector to Tempo, Prometheus and Loki, giving one connected trace from the gateway through downstream services into Kafka

Designed the async integration layer: services communicate only through Kafka (3-partition topic, consumer groups fanning out to notification, analytics and audit) and RabbitMQ (webhooks with exponential backoff over 3 attempts and a dead-letter queue); event publishing is best-effort, so a broker outage degrades the pipeline without failing the write

Built the NestJS API gateway as the single entry point: strips client-supplied identity headers, rejects malformed requests before any JWT crypto runs, validates the token and injects identity headers downstream services trust

Deployed on Kubernetes (k3s) via Helm charts with liveness/readiness probes and ConfigMap/Secret separation, provisioned with Terraform and Ansible; GitHub Actions pipelines test, build, push SHA-pinned images and verify the rollout
Built MongoDB-backed services (Mongoose profile service, Go analytics service with aggregation pipelines) alongside NestJS

projects.name: QuizForge
projects.description: LLM quiz generation (NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Claude API)
bullets: Built a resilient third-party (LLM) integration layer: daily budget guard, Redis cache, retries with jittered backoff, and zod schema validation with one repair call
Streamed results as JSON Lines over Server-Sent Events: each item is validated and saved as soon as its line completes, and reconnecting clients replay saved items before live events

Tested with Vitest unit and Supertest e2e suites on real PostgreSQL and Redis; GitHub Actions also runs a Playwright test on the full Docker stack and fails the build on OpenAPI or generated-type drift
Built with Claude Code in 11 phases, approving a written plan for each and verifying it against lint and tests

projects.name: Taskflow

bullets: Persisted structured logs to PostgreSQL, queryable by level and context, and exposed health checks plus request-rate and resource metrics to Prometheus and Grafana
Added Redis caching with TTL control and graceful fallback on cache failure; covered REST and GraphQL APIs with Jest unit and e2e tests and automated deployment to AWS EC2 via GitHub Actions
